metadata.memory_measurement: Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS peak working set and peak pagefile usage (commit); per worker process, includes runtime startup
metadata.format_scope: index bytes only; no envelope, prefix, version, checksum, whitespace policy, or empty-index marker

X6_text_sample.extraction: document body paragraphs and table rows in order; cells joined with ' | '; UTF-8 with LF separators
